title: MES Business Analyst(Aveva)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para MES Business Analyst(Aveva) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary:

  • Our client is looking for a MES Global Business Analyst. Needs to have senior level MES skills, with at least 1 Aveva project. Focus is more from the business side but needs to be able to interact with the technical team and will need some hands on Aveva experience.
  • This role supports a large-scale MES program across 26 sites, acting as a global business system owner with strong functional accountability for harmonizing manufacturing processes, shaping MES capabilities, and ensuring business alignment across implementations.


Responsibilities

  • Collect user requirements from sites and drive standardization and harmonization of MES-supported manufacturing processes
  • Support the definition of core MES data structures such as Master batch records, materials, resources, and master data
  • Review functional solution design proposed by the system integrator and escalate gaps, risks, or misalignment with business needs
  • Monitor and control solution definition across multiple parallel implementations to ensure consistency of core MES functions
  • Oversee UAT preparation and execution, ensuring test scenarios adequately cover critical manufacturing and compliance processes
  • Assess change impacts at site level, including process adoption, training needs, and local operational readiness
  • Production of project status reports and functional progress updates for MES deployments
  • Escalation management for process, design, and deployment issues affecting MES implementation
  • Coordination of cross-functional teams involved in MES design, testing, and rollout
  • Support global business activities related to manufacturing execution, electronic batch records, and process standardization
  • Support the global business application owner in functional maintenance, enhancement prioritization, and solution testing and governance


Required Qualifications

  • At least 5-7 years of experience in OT/IT projects within manufacturing, including significant exposure to MES implementation as a business representative or functional lead
  • Strong functional understanding of MES capabilities such as electronic batch records, recipe/workflow execution, material traceability, review by exception, and equipment status management
  • Experience translating site business needs into user requirements, process flows, and harmonized global solutions
  • Experience in GxP-regulated environments, ideally within pharmaceutical manufacturing
  • Good knowledge of pharma manufacturing processes, including batch execution, dispensing, weighing, and quality-related process controls
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery models is preferred
  • Experience in MES implementation projects within regulated manufacturing environments, ideally in Pharma
  • Functional exposure to MES-related capabilities such as eBR, batch execution, material genealogy, deviation handling, review by exception, and integration with ERP/LIMS/warehouse systems
  • Experience with GxP documentation, validation support, and controlled deployment of digital manufacturing solutions
  • Ability to quickly understand and adopt new MES platforms and technologies


Musts:

  • Minimum of 5-7 years MES experience
  • At least 1 project on Aveva MES
  • Business Analyst experience, with enough technical expertise to interface with the technical team
  • Integration with SAP
  • Integration with the L2 layer (Scada, PLCs etc), so they can understand process flows
  • Experience with eBR, batch execution
  • UAT experience
  • Latin America based


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with other MES solutions would be nice to have, not essential
  • Brazil based

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

Job Responsibilities:

Job Title: Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst

Introduction: We are seeking an experienced Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst to join our team and play a critical role in supporting the business across a broad spectrum of global import and export compliance matters. This position is vital in ensuring our compliance with international trade regulations while enabling data-driven decision-making through the creation of innovative dashboards and reports. The successful candidate will leverage their expertise in global trade compliance and advanced analytics tools to model the potential impact of tariffs on the business model and drive continuous improvement in compliance processes.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with regional trade compliance teams and business stakeholders to gather, document, and refine business requirements and functional processes, adapting them as business needs evolve.
  • Maintain and oversee day-to-day global classification processes to support global import volumes, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
  • Assist with technology, hardware, and software trade classification, including management of Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) , Schedule B , and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) classifications.
  • Manage compliance activities equally focused on imports and exports (50% each).
  • Develop and contribute to documented classification justifications based on the General Rules of Interpretation (GRI) foundation for global import classifications.
  • Provide import compliance guidance in adherence to US and international regulations, including conducting research, updating status reports, and coordinating deliverables within the team.
  • Build, maintain, and analyze data-informed metrics to generate actionable insights that enhance the global trade compliance program.
  • Establish and nurture positive business relationships with key stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • Engage with software development teams to understand and influence evolving compliance technology, identifying opportunities to automate manual processes.
  • Generate and contribute to performance requirements, timelines, and metrics for all related activities.
  • Support project management efforts to ensure timely delivery of team assignments and objectives.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably within supply chain, logistics, or global trade compliance environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear documentation including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and detailed reports.
  • Proven experience with global trade compliance regulations, including import/export laws and logistics preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently research and dive deep into complex compliance requests and issues.


Tools and Technologies:

  • Proficient in Smartsheet , Power BI , and AWS Quicksight with hands-on experience creating new dashboards, running data batches, and developing meaningful metrics and reports.
  • Strong data analytics and data entry skills to support compliance reporting and insights generation.
  • Familiarity with trade classification tools and regulatory databases is a plus.


Skills:

Global trade compliance, Smartsheet, Power BI, AWS Quicksight

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI-Native
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI-Native em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Zaigo builds AI software for real businesses.
Not demos. Not slide decks. Actual tools that people use to run parts of their company.
Our clients are usually owner-led or mid-market companies in the US: professional services firms, distributors, manufacturers, healthcare operators, finance teams. They have messy workflows, old systems, weird data, and very little patience for theory. We figure out what should exist, then we build it.
We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer who already builds heavily with AI. Someone who can take a vague client problem, turn it into a product plan, build the thing, polish it, ship it, and keep moving.
If you need perfect specs, this probably is not the job. If you like owning the whole problem and moving faster than normal teams think is reasonable, it might be.
What the work looks like
You will own client projects end to end.
That means you may be on a call with a business owner in the morning, designing the workflow after lunch, and shipping the first usable version that week. The work is full-stack product engineering: database, backend, UI, auth, integrations, AI agents, evals, error handling, deployment, and the judgment to know what should not be handled by a model.
Recent Zaigo-style projects include:
a document review tool that checks presentations against a firm's brand and compliance rules
a benchmarking platform built from years of public company filings
payroll and operations tools that clean messy data and produce files people can actually use
internal AI agents that help teams move faster without giving the model dangerous autonomy
You do not need to be an ML researcher. You do need to be a very strong engineer who knows how to use AI tools to ship better and faster.
Who we are looking for
You are probably a fit if this sounds like you:
You have 5+ years building software professionally.
You can ship across the stack: frontend, backend, database, integrations, deployment.
You use AI coding tools every day, not as a novelty. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, agents, worktrees, parallel terminals, your own setup. We care less about the exact tools and more about whether you have real opinions from using them.
You think like a product owner. You ask what the user is trying to do, what the first useful version should be, and what will make people trust the system.
You can work with ambiguity. Clients rarely hand you perfect requirements.
You have taste. There is no reason to ship ugly software anymore.
You communicate clearly in English and can talk through tradeoffs with US clients.
You have high initiative. You fix things nobody assigned. You build outside work because you like building.
Bonus points if you have founded something, freelanced, run a small agency, built your own product, or worked directly with clients.
Who should not apply
This is probably not the right role if you want a narrow lane, a long roadmap, and fully written tickets.
It is also probably not right if your AI experience is mostly prompting ChatGPT, building toy demos, or talking about agents without shipping production software.
We need builders. Smart, fast, practical builders.
Process
Short application.
10-minute async voice interview.
Live interview with Zaigo's founder.
Short practical build project.
Offer if it is a fit.
We move quickly. If there is a fit, you will hear from us within days, not weeks.
